content: Namely, when the word immediately following the question word is a Noun, window size is set to ‘3’. The window size ‘3’ means we iterate through the next ‘3’ words to check if any of the word is both Noun and Subject, If so, such word is considered the ‘LAT’; else the word that is present very next to the question word is considered as the ‘LAT’.
